title.en: Japan wants a piece of a Martian moon. Why does NASA get 15%?
title.zh: 日本要带回一块火星卫星，NASA为何分得15%？

summary.en: MMX targets an October19 US-time launch and a2031 sample return. Its instruments may settle a moon-origin puzzle; none of those future milestones is achieved yet.
summary.zh: MMX目标美东10月19日发射、2031年返样，仪器或解卫星身世之谜；这些未来里程碑尚未实现。

title.en: 11,000 people heard about an app. Why did a trusted company hurt trust in government?
title.zh: 逾1.1万人听说一款政务平台，为何可信公司反让政府失分？

summary.en: A Kenya survey separates willingness to use a service from trust in its public provider. Private-brand appeal need not transfer political confidence.
summary.zh: 肯尼亚调查区分使用意愿与政府信任：企业品牌的吸引力，未必能转移政治信任。
